messages:
Maya (Sales): Acme wants a 3-week POC in us-west-2. Requirements: BYO-CMK with HSM attestation, ability to trigger quarterly rotations, decrypt audit trail per request, target 450 rps and median token latency <60ms. Can we do it?
Diego (Solutions Eng): Yes. For latency we'll enable prefix KV caching + ephemeral wrapping to avoid per-token KMS unwraps. That should keep p50 low.
acme-rep: Attestation must include HSM model and date of last attestation. Also need a rotation dry-run where we trigger rotation and observe no downtime.
Rhea (CryptoOps): We can provide HSM model info and a PDF attestation. Rotation dry-run: staged dual-wrap, 15% traffic shift, validate signatures and logs, finalize. We'll run in staging first and share runbook.
Omar (SRE): I'll spin up staging and run a synthetic load. Need Acme to whitelist staging IPs. Also will use --prefetch-kv and --ephemeral-wrap flags.
Maya (Sales): Pricing ask: include X KMS calls in POC allowance. Post-POC, KMS passthrough or managed-key premium. I'll confirm numbers in SOW.
acme-rep: Whitelist done, NDA addendum attached. Also Q on audit logs: we need per-decrypt entry with request id and key alias.
Rhea (CryptoOps): We emit per-decrypt audit entries with key alias, request id, caller id, and timestamp. We'll include sample log format in the questionnaire response.
Omar (SRE): Smoke run: p50=38ms p95=82ms with ephemeral-wrap off. With prefetch+ephemeral we expect p95 ~65ms. Starting 450 rps run now.
Omar (SRE): Load run result: sustained 450 rps for 5m, p50=40ms p95=67ms, no errors.
Maya (Sales): Action items: Rhea attach attestation + runbook (48h), Omar deliver full load logs (24h), Sales finalize KMS budget line (EOD).
acme-rep: Thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround.
